d2_status_change.what_changed: D3 added the AERO reward APR layer (observed 63.52% from DefiLlama). The reward thickens the edge from D2's $6.83 to D3's $8.32 on the same cell. The edge is also robust to reward scenario (GO at 0%, 15%, 31.76%, 63.52%, 100% reward scenarios for the best cell).

why_D3_matters: D3 finds the missing layer that turns D2's marginal edge into a robust GO. The Aerodrome AERO reward APR is 63.52% (DefiLlama) for 0xb2cc, which adds 22% to the D2 base edge. The model is now robust to: (1) funding stress (median to p5, all positive), (2) reward scenario (0% to 100%, all positive at $1000), (3) hedge ratio (0.5 and 0.75 both have GO cells). The min viable capital is $250, well below the $1000 spec limit. The next stages (D4 paper validation, D5 auto-exit engineering, D6 live probe) are the right path to execution. The freeze is preserved — the GO is plan only.
remaining_blockers: DefiLlama's 63.52% APR is a 30-day rolling average; realized 24h reward could vary. D4 paper validation needed.
Auto-exit wiring still missing (P0 from R3); required before any live probe
Actual execution costs (slippage, market impact, rebalance tx size, AERO claim mechanics) not modeled
The 0x72ab (PancakeSwap) pool has no Aerodrome reward, so the GO applies only to 0xb2cc. The PancakeSwap pool would need its own reward source (CAKE emissions) to be GO.

DefiLlama's apyBase (29.87%) is much lower than R4C's measured 226% (single 24h). The model uses R4C's actual fee rate, but the reward APR is from DefiLlama, which is a 30-day average. The 24h realized reward could be ±50% of the 30-day average.
next_recommended_stage: D4 — Paper / shadow validation. Run the best cell ($250 LP on 0xb2cc ±2% 24h, 0.75 hedge, gt_2pct rebalance) in real time for 7d. Compare to D3's model predictions. If within 20%, proceed to D5 (auto-exit wiring) and then D6 (live probe). Each step requires explicit user authorization. The freeze is preserved.
